scope: Source statement comparison, not a replacement for exact-source proof. Glyph full-proof/build receipt is included; fused full proof remains pending.

added.tiles_table_extension_exact:
law tiles_table_extension_exact:
  for k: Nat
  for +e: Nat
  for +old: R.Tab
  for +new: R.Tab
  for +ops: List<&2, R.Op>
  for +base: Image
  for +rx: U32
  for +ry: U32
  for +n: U32
  for +h: {T.Tiles.agrees(T.Tiles.make(k, e, old, ops, base, rx, ry, n), old, new) == True{} : Bool}
  {T.Tiles.make(k, e, new, ops, base, rx, ry, n) == T.Tiles.make(k, e, old, ops, base, rx, ry, n) : T.Tiles}

seek_made.before:
law seek_made:
  for k: Nat
  for +e: Nat
  for +old: List<&2, R.Op>
  for +b0: Image
  for +mx: U32
  for +my: U32
  for +mn: U32
  for +x: U32
  for +y: U32
  for +rx: U32
  for +ry: U32
  for +n: U32
  for +l: List<&2, R.Op>
  for +base: Image
  {T.Tiles.seek(k, T.Tiles.make(k, e, old, b0, mx, my, mn), x, y, rx, ry, n, e, l, base) == T.Tile.draw(e, l, base) : Image}
seek_made.after:
law seek_made:
  for +tab: R.Tab
  for k: Nat
  for +e: Nat
  for +old: List<&2, R.Op>
  for +b0: Image
  for +mx: U32
  for +my: U32
  for +mn: U32
  for +x: U32
  for +y: U32
  for +rx: U32
  for +ry: U32
  for +n: U32
  for +l: List<&2, R.Op>
  for +base: Image
  {T.Tiles.seek(k, T.Tiles.make(k, e, tab, old, b0, mx, my, mn), x, y, rx, ry, n, e, tab, l, base) == T.Tile.draw(e, tab, l, base) : Image}
seek_made.guarantee_mapping: Same exact scratch tile image for arbitrary glyph table; table is an additional universally quantified argument.

tile_keep.before:
law tile_keep:
  for +e: Nat
  for +ops: List<&2, R.Op>
  for +l: List<&2, R.Op>
  for +base: Image
  for +img: Image
  for +p: T.Past
  for +rx: U32
  for +ry: U32
  for +n: U32
  {T.Tile.again(e, ops, base, T.Tile{ops, l, base, img}, p, rx, ry, n) == T.Tile{ops, l, base, img} : T.Tile}
tile_keep.after:
law tile_keep:
  for +tab: R.Tab
  for +e: Nat
  for +ops: List<&2, R.Op>
  for +l: List<&2, R.Op>
  for +base: Image
  for +img: Image
  for +keys: T.KeySet
  for +p: T.Past
  for +rx: U32
  for +ry: U32
  for +n: U32
  {T.Tile.again(e, tab, ops, base, T.Tile{ops, l, base, img, keys}, p, rx, ry, n) == T.Tile{ops, l, base, img, keys} : T.Tile}
tile_keep.guarantee_mapping: Same unchanged tile retained, now including arbitrary exact key summary and arbitrary glyph table.

frame_again_exact.before:
law frame_again_exact:
  for +w0: U32
  for +h0: U32
  for +w: U32
  for +h: U32
  for +ops: List<&2, R.Op>
  for +old: List<&2, R.Op>
  for +base0: Image
  for +base: Image
  for +dy: U32
  {T.Frame.again(w, h, ops, base, T.FSome{w0, h0, T.Frame.make(w0, h0, old, base0)}, dy) == T.Frame.make(w, h, ops, base) : T.Tiles}
frame_again_exact.after:
law frame_again_exact:
  for +tab: R.Tab
  for +tab0: R.Tab
  for +w0: U32
  for +h0: U32
  for +w: U32
  for +h: U32
  for +ops: List<&2, R.Op>
  for +old: List<&2, R.Op>
  for +base0: Image
  for +base: Image
  for +dy: U32
  {T.Frame.again(w, h, ops, base, tab, T.FSome{w0, h0, tab0, T.Frame.make(w0, h0, old, base0, tab0)}, dy) == T.Frame.make(w, h, ops, base, tab) : T.Tiles}
frame_again_exact.guarantee_mapping: Same exact scratch frame; independent arbitrary old and new glyph tables are additionally quantified, with no equality precondition.

drawn_get_run.before:
law drawn_get_run:
  for t: T.Jobs
  for path: List<&2, Bool>
  for +e: Nat
  for +l: List<&2, R.Op>
  for +base: Image
  {T.Drawn.get(T.Jobs.run(t, e), path, e, l, base) == T.Tile.draw(e, l, base) : Image}
drawn_get_run.after:
law drawn_get_run:
  for +tab: R.Tab
  for t: T.Jobs
  for path: List<&2, Bool>
  for +e: Nat
  for +l: List<&2, R.Op>
  for +base: Image
  {T.Drawn.get(T.Jobs.run(t, e, tab), path, e, tab, l, base) == T.Tile.draw(e, tab, l, base) : Image}
drawn_get_run.guarantee_mapping: Same exact scratch tile image whichever balanced jobs path is used; arbitrary table is additionally quantified.

plan_fill_again.before:

  for k: Nat
  for +e: Nat
  for +ops: List<&2, R.Op>
  for +base: Image
  for prev: T.Tiles
  for +p: T.Past
  for +rx: U32
  for +ry: U32
  for +n: U32
  for +off: Nat
  for +t: T.Jobs
  {T.Plan.fill(T.Tiles.plan(k, e, ops, base, prev, p, rx, ry, n), e, off, T.Jobs.run(t, e)) == T.Tiles.again(k, e, ops, base, prev, p, rx, ry, n) : T.Tiles}
plan_fill_again.after:
law plan_fill_again:
  for +tab: R.Tab
  for k: Nat
  for +e: Nat
  for +ops: List<&2, R.Op>
  for +base: Image
  for prev: T.Tiles
  for +p: T.Past
  for +rx: U32
  for +ry: U32
  for +n: U32
  for +off: Nat
  for +t: T.Jobs
  {T.Plan.fill(T.Tiles.plan(k, e, ops, base, prev, p, rx, ry, n), e, tab, off, T.Jobs.run(t, e, tab)) == T.Tiles.again(k, e, tab, ops, base, prev, p, rx, ry, n) : T.Tiles}
plan_fill_again.guarantee_mapping: Same equality between planned/filled tiles and sequential redraw for arbitrary jobs/offsets; arbitrary table is additionally quantified.
